sloka: देवान्तकाय तं वीरश्चिक्षेप सहसा ऽङ्गदः।महावृक्षं महाशाखं शक्रो दीप्तमिवाशनिम् ।। ६.७०.६ ।।
transliteration: devāntakāya taṁ vīraścikṣepa sahasā 'ṅgadaḥ।mahāvṛkṣaṁ mahāśākhaṁ śakro dīptamivāśanim ।। 6.70.6 ।।

translations.english: Just as Indra took a flaming thunderbolt, Angada, the hero took hold of huge branches of trees and hurled at Devanthaka with force.
